name: Ubiqconn Technology, Inc.
summary: Ubiqconn Technology, Inc. specializes in the manufacturing and global distribution of various tech products, including industrial computers, in-vehicle systems, electronic components, and related peripheral equipment. The company further offers durable mobile solutions specifically designed for demanding environments in sectors such as satellite communications (SATCOM), agriculture, logistics, maritime, transportation, and government. Established in Taipei City, Taiwan, in 2011, Ubiqconn maintains an extensive international operational footprint, encompassing Taiwan, the United States, the Netherlands, Brazil, and Australia. The firm operates as a subsidiary of FIC Global, Inc.
